newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway debt firmer, crown seen weaker near term.
newsitem.headline: Norway debt firmer, crown seen weaker near term.

text.p: Norwegian bonds climbed along with stronger markets abroad, following Monday's strong performance in U.S. Treasuries.
Chase Manhattan Bank in a market report said it expected the Norwegian crown to weaken over the next few weeks but to appreciate in the new year.
"Bank of Norway may have won the battle against the crown's appreciation, but not necessarily the entire war," the report said.
"A trade surplus and continued positive interest rate differentials to most other European currencies may result in another crown buying spree in the new year."
The central bank on November 5 cut its key rates to try and dampen the strong appreciation of the crown.
